column1: # regex acceptance vectors, from ECMA-262 22.2.
# The validator is a structural check (balanced parens, terminated classes,
# defined escapes), so it accepts ECMA-262 patterns RE2 rejects and rejects only
# structurally malformed patterns. The official suite's
# optional/format/ecmascript-regex.json tests pattern semantics rather than this
# grammar check.
# Format: three tab-separated fields, "<input>"\t<valid>\t<note>. The input is a
# Go quoted string literal in the spelling strconv.Quote produces. '#' lines and
# blank lines are skipped.

column1: [abc]
# ECMA-262 22.2.1 defines CharacterClass as '[' [lookahead != ^] ClassContents
# ']' with ClassContents permitted to be empty, and ClassAtomNoDash excludes an
# unescaped ']', so the first unescaped ']' always closes the class. 6c3c47a
# read the POSIX bracket expression instead and rejected the empty class;
# fdbad66 restored it. These rows are why the question does not reopen.
